tooltip.grimpipes.chemical_pipe: Moves Mekanism chemicals: gases, infuse types, pigments and slurries.
tooltip.grimpipes.omni_pipe: Moves items, fluids, energy and chemicals on one strand.
tooltip.grimpipes.pipe.bundle: Right-click a placed pipe to add this strand into the same block.
tooltip.grimpipes.upgrade: Speed card for one Input end. Right-click an Input end with it, or put it in the end's card slot (empty-hand right-click the end).
tooltip.grimpipes.wrench.1: Click a pipe end: switch Output / Input
tooltip.grimpipes.wrench.2: Sneak-click an end or click a link: disconnect
tooltip.grimpipes.wrench.3: Click a pipe core facing a side: reconnect it
tooltip.grimpipes.wrench.4: Sneak-click a core: take that strand out
message.grimpipes.wrench.nothing: %s is already connected on the %s side (or there is nothing there)
message.grimpipes.upgrade.already: This end already has a %s card
tooltip.grimpipes.pipe.cards: Only Input ends need speed cards, never the pipes in between.
tooltip.grimpipes.wrench.5: Empty hand on an Input end: card slot and filter
message.grimpipes.upgrade.input_only: Speed cards go in an Input end. Set one with the wrench, then click its end plate.
message.grimpipes.gui.output_end: This is an Output end. Switch it to Input with the wrench to give it a card and filter.
gui.grimpipes.theme.tooltip: Switch screen style: Reaper / Vanilla / Dark
gui.grimpipes.card.tooltip: Speed card slot: Whispering, Restless, Wraithbound or Soulforged. Empty = Hollow speed.
gui.grimpipes.filter.tooltip: Click with an item to add it, click with an empty hand to clear. Shift-click items in your inventory to add them. Buckets filter fluids.
gui.grimpipes.mode.whitelist.tooltip: Only pulls what is in the filter.
gui.grimpipes.mode.blacklist.tooltip: Pulls everything except what is in the filter. An empty blacklist pulls everything.
gui.grimpipes.mode.void.tooltip: Pulls everything, and DELETES whatever is in the filter instead of sending it on.
gui.grimpipes.end.subtitle: Input end, %s side
